## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the reason for it.

## Validation

- [ ] The add-on version and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated when behavior or metadata changed.
- [ ] Container images and runtime dependencies are pinned to immutable versions where possible.
- [ ] Home Assistant metadata lint passes.
- [ ] ShellCheck passes for changed shell scripts.
- [ ] Every advertised architecture builds successfully.
- [ ] A runtime smoke test verifies the service endpoint and persistent data.
- [ ] Home Assistant integration was tested, or the add-on remains `experimental`.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or personal data are included.
